scope: Four proposed written everyday tasks for adult Russian-speaking learners; no oral, listening, full A1 or CEFR attainment claim.
publication_gate: Internal source-based content, answer, translation and rights decision required for each selected item before P1 activation.

outcomes.input: Fictional short registration prompt with only name, place and one requested field.
outcomes.written_task: Fill requested details in a short fictional registration form.
outcomes.rubric: Score each requested field separately; record legibility and target form separately; accept reviewed Cyrillic or Latin spellings; an absent field is not a wrong grammar form.
outcomes.script_conditions: Prompt may be Cyrillic or Latin; response may use either script consistently; no transliteration duplicate as a new assessment.
outcomes.hypothesis: A fictional form can probe selected written personal details, not general conversation or all A1 forms.

outcomes.input: Short fictional counter notice naming one available item.
outcomes.written_task: Write a bounded polite request for that item.
outcomes.rubric: Score intended item and request function separately from a reviewed target phrase; unresolved but plausible alternatives require editorial review.
outcomes.script_conditions: Read and write either script; no spoken interaction is assessed.
outcomes.hypothesis: A written rehearsal of a request samples a narrow function, not the oral descriptor itself.

outcomes.input: Short fictional price notice with two labelled items.
outcomes.written_task: Find and write the price of the named item.
outcomes.rubric: Score item–price match and numeral separately; do not infer broader menu reading or number agreement.
outcomes.script_conditions: Notice script is recorded; digits are allowed for the answer.
outcomes.hypothesis: A two-item notice can test a selected written price lookup without establishing general reading level.

outcomes.input: Fictional message asking where an identified meeting place is.
outcomes.written_task: Write one short location message about that place.
outcomes.rubric: Score referent and location separately from a reviewed location construction; do not score route-giving or spoken directions.
outcomes.script_conditions: Prompt script is recorded; reviewed answers may use either Serbian script.
outcomes.hypothesis: A short written message samples location expression, not navigation competence.
